answer_text:
Here are some funny, quirky, and downright weird habits that many people have — you might even recognize a few of your own!

---

### 🎨 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
Some people doodle during phone calls to help keep themselves focused — and sometimes they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone!

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. It's frustrating how the most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while you're shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🛑 4. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people, every time they set down a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace, point at it and tell it to "stay" out loud, like you would a dog. They never thought it was weird until someone asked if they were afraid it would walk off — but to them, they're more telling it not to fall or get lost.

---

### 🗑️ 5. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, gum wrappers — anything that can be folded once they're done with its contents gets neatly folded into a square.

---

### 🥦 6. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat things separately — for example, eating all the chicken first, then all the broccoli. Many don't even know it's considered weird until someone else points it out.

---

### 🥛 7. Shaking the Milk Jug
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring a glass. For one person, it was because they were raised on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk — and they were about 30 before someone asked why, making them realize they didn't need to do it with store-bought milk.

---

### 😱 8. Running After Turning Off the Lights
Some people bolt toward their room as soon as they switch off the hall light, convinced that if they ever look back, something creepy from a horror movie will be right behind them.

---

### 🥫 9. Tapping a Can Before Opening It
Some people tap the lid of a can three times before opening it when drinking soda or beer. One person had no idea why or even that they were doing it until someone noticed and assumed it was for luck — so they just went with that explanation!

---

### 🍽️ 10. More Extreme Habits: Pica
On the more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, which is known as pica. Others might have a habit of pulling out their hair or obsessively washing their hands.

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but some of our tendencies are more common than you might think! So if you recognized yourself in any of these, don't worry — you're definitely not alone! 😄
